units.text: The 2025 Nobel Chemistry Prize was awarded to Kitagawa, Robson, and Yaghi for the development of metal-organic frameworks. The prize announcement was made in Stockholm, Sweden by the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences.

judgement.reason: The passages confirm the 2025 Nobel Chemistry Prize was awarded to Kitagawa, Robson, and Yaghi for the development of metal-organic frameworks, but they do not state that the prize announcement was made in Stockholm, Sweden.
